Stop_New_Credit_Applications.description: Composition (Subset). Stopping new applications reduces recent inquiry counts.

Build_Satisfactory_Credit_History.description: Composition (Sum). Accumulating more satisfactory trades increases total trade count.

Pay_Down_Revolving_Debt.description: Latent Behavior. Paying down balances reduces utilization and high-utilization trade counts.

Increase_Online_Participation.description: Latent Behavior. Actively participating in the course increases interaction counts for forums, content, and homepage.

Reduce_Spending_Habits.description: Momentum. Reducing spending habits lowers bill amounts sequentially over time.

Improve_Payment_Consistency.description: Momentum. Consistently paying on time improves the trajectory of payment status history.
